scene: You step off the wooden koi boat onto the canal workshop dock.
picture: Flat side view along the canal dock. Far left, a bronze robot heron watches a carp-shaped boat tied up. Left of centre, the grandfather pushes his plant-laden bicycle past drying painted umbrellas. Right, a repair shed displays hanging spanners, while far right, glowing orange koi swim in turquoise water.
shown: a sleek bronze robot heron standing still far left by the water
bright patterned paper umbrellas drying on low bamboo racks centre
a cluttered wooden bicycle repair shed with its sliding door open right

variants.scene: Evening air smells of canal water as glowing lanterns illuminate the quiet quayside workshop.
Humming {tune}, you wheel your trusty bicycle onto the warm canal dock.
Orange koi glide beneath the planks as dusk settles over the peaceful alley.
